Private Caboose- seats up to 15, our caboose is roomy and comfortable with a table and chairs. This is usually located directly behind the locomotive. services.name: Autumn Explorer
services.desc: Join us for a 90 min trip to Greenfield and back! Enjoy then scenic views of the Southern Adirondacks as the leaves change colors. We pass marshes and swamps with beautiful views and wildlife. Don't forget your binoculars. Guests have the option to choose: FIRST CLASS - table seating with 4 at a table, climate controlled car and includes a glass bottle of Saratoga Water. COACH - standard Amtrak style coach seating, great for families. Seats face each other in 4 packs or 2 packs school bus style. services.name: The Pumpkin Picker
services.desc: Don’t miss this unique experience! Duration 1.5 Hours About Join us on a 1.5 hour adventure to the pumpkin patch! Each child will be allowed to pick a pumpkin and decorate it on the way back!!! Apple Cider and snacks will be available when we reach Kings Station for all guests! First Class seating is available in our dining car. Each table has 4 chairs. Open air seating is available on our flat car. This is picnic table style seating.
